51595459.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to CM5 sensor chip immobilized SARS-CoV-2 3CL protease assessed as dissociation constant by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - Surface plasmon: The biomolecular interaction between 8h and 3CLpro or TMPRSS2 was analyzed by SPR using the Biacore™ T200 system (GE Healthcare, US). All proteins were purchased from CusabioCompany (www.cusabio.cn). The S series CM5 sensor chip and amine coupling kit was purchased from GE Healthcare (Uppsala, Sweden). CM5 sensor chip was activated by using 1-ethyl-3-(3-dimethylaminopropyl) carbodiimide hydrochloride (EDC)/N-hydroxy succinimide (NHS). Each chip was subsequently immobilized with the recombinant humanTMPRSS2 protein or SARS-CoV-2 3CLpro separately at a concentration of 50 μg/mL in sodium acetate solution (pH 4.0) and then blocked with ethanolamine. Various concentrations of 8h were injected for method validation at a flow rate of 10 μL/min in 5 % DMSO/PBS-P running buffer with 60 s of association and 60 s of dissociation. The compound DMSO was further diluted with PBS-P buffer and analyzed at a final concentration of 100 μM (with 5 % DMSO (v/v)). Data were processed by subtracting responses from the reference flow cell and the blank cycles. All data were analyzed by the kinetic model in the Biacore™ T200 Evaluation Software 2.0 (GE Healthcare, US), and Kd was applied to evaluate the binding affinity.
original_paragraph.Figure 7 caption: Fig. 7. Target protein analysis and verification. (A and B) SPR sensorgrams and affinity chart obtained on a SARS-CoV-2 3CLpro-coated chip at different concentrations of 8h and 8b. (C) The pictures show the site docking and binding pockets of 8h with 3CLpro (PDB ID: 7RFW). The structural alignment and graphical representation were generated using Pymol software. (D) The enzyme inhibition of 3CLpro by 8h. Data analysis of IC50 values was determined from GraphPad Prism 8.
original_paragraph.Figure 7B - Sensorgram data: The SPR sensorgrams in Figure 7B show the response over time for different concentrations of 8h (0.39, 0.78, 1.56, 3.125, 6.25, 12.5, 25, 50 μM) and 8b (0.39, 0.78, 1.56, 3.125, 6.25, 12.5, 25, 50 μM) binding to the 3CLpro-coated chip. The x-axis represents time (s) from -20 to 100, with the association phase from 0 to 60 s and dissociation from 60 to 100 s. The y-axis represents Relative Response (RU). The affinity chart in Figure 7B shows the equilibrium response (RU) versus concentration (μM) for 8h, with a fitted curve indicating a Kd value of 11.79 μM.
original_paragraph.Figure 7D - Enzyme inhibition data: The enzyme inhibition curve in Figure 7D shows the normalized inhibition (%) of 3CLpro by 8h as a function of concentration (μM). The curve is fitted, and the IC50 value is labeled as 38.27 μM. A separate curve for inhibition by Ebselen is also shown with an IC50 value of 0.7046 μM.

original_paragraph.Figure 6 caption: Fig. 6. Target protein analysis and verification. (A) Molecular docking for host TMPRSS2 (PDB ID: 7MEQ) with 8h. (B) SPR sensorgrams obtained on a TMPRSS2-coated chip at different concentrations of 8h. (C) The enzyme inhibition of human TMPRSS2 by 8h. original_paragraph.Figure 6B sensorgram data: The SPR sensorgrams in Figure 6B show the relative response (RU) over time (s) for 8h at concentrations of 1.56 μM, 3.125 μM, 6.25 μM, 12.5 μM, 25 μM, 50 μM, and 100 μM. The x-axis ranges from -30 to 100 seconds, with the association phase from 0 to 60 seconds and dissociation from 60 to 100 seconds. The y-axis ranges from -2 to 6 RU. original_paragraph.Figure 6C data: The enzyme inhibition curve in Figure 6C shows the normalized inhibition (%) versus concentration (μM) for 8h. The curve is fitted, and the IC50 value is labeled as 3.37 μM. The x-axis ranges from 0 to 100 μM, and the y-axis ranges from 0 to 150%.
